u0: This is the starting state: the ball has not yet been cleared from the doorway, the matching key has not been obtained, the door is closed, and the target box is not held. First move the ball away from the door; only then take the matching key, then open the door with it, and finally pick up the designated box in the other room. Taking the key before clearing the ball violates a mandatory ordering condition and irreversibly fails the mission.
u1: A mandatory ordering condition has been broken, such as taking the matching key before the ball has been cleared from the doorway. The episode has irreversibly failed, so successful completion is no longer possible and the designated box cannot be collected as required.
u2: The ball has been cleared from the doorway at least once, but the door is still closed and the matching key is not in hand. Next take the matching key, then unlock and open the door, and finally pick up the designated box in the other room. If the ball has been dropped back in front of the door, clear it again before attempting to open the door. Once you take the key, keep it until the door is open, since dropping it while the door is closed violates the stated preference.
u3: The ball has been cleared from the doorway and the matching key has been taken, but the door is still closed. If you are holding the key, open the door with it now; if it has been dropped, pick it up again first, and if the ball is back in front of the door, clear it again before opening. After the door is open, go to the other room and pick up the designated box. Dropping the key while the door remains closed violates the preference, so keep it until the door has been opened.
u4: The ball has been cleared, the matching key has been acquired, and the door has been opened, but the designated box has not yet been picked up. The remaining goal is to reach the other room and pick up that box, setting the key down first if it is still in hand so the box can be taken. If the door has been shut again or the ball has been put back in the doorway, reopen or clear the way as needed. Dropping the key while the door is open is safe, but doing so while the door is closed would violate the preference.
u5: The designated box has been picked up after the ball was cleared, the matching key was acquired, and the door was opened, so all mandatory requirements are satisfied. The mission is complete and the episode ends with this pickup; no further action is required.
u6: The door was successfully opened earlier but is currently shut again, and the designated box has not yet been picked up. The matching key may still be held or may have been dropped; if you need to cross from the starting side, reopen the door, retrieving the key first if necessary. If you are already in the box room, you can simply pick up the box, because the required opening has already occurred. Dropping the key while the door is closed breaks the stated preference, so open the door before letting go of the key if you still hold it.
